items.heading: Name Which Subject Is Actually
items.text: Name which subject is actually slipping. Be specific, a dropping test score in one subject over several months is a signal, not a bad week.

items.heading: Check Whether You Can Still
items.text: Check whether you can still recover it with a focused plan. Sometimes a subject slips because of a gap in one topic area, not a fundamental mismatch. A tutor or a focused revision block can fix that.

items.heading: If IT Does Not Recover,
items.text: If it does not recover, drop early rather than late. A drop made in early or mid-11th protects your other three subjects. A drop forced by panic in 12th costs you far more.

items.heading: Reframe the Drop As
items.text: Reframe the drop as a decision, not a defeat. You tested both sides honestly and chose one with real evidence. That is exactly what the extra subject was for.
